title: When Do Supervised UQ Ensembles Improve LLM Hallucination Detection? A Robustness Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.24492v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods are widely used for hallucination detection in large language models (LLMs) in closed-book settings where ground-truth evidence is unavailable at inference time. Prior work has proposed combining UQ signals via learned ensembles, but empirical investigations into the robustness of these ensembles are limited. We study a supervised ensembling framework that trains a classifier over heterogeneous UQ-based scorer outputs on a small, domain-specific dataset of labeled LLM responses, then applies it to out-of-sample hallucination classification without retrieval, tools, or reference documents. Across four LLMs, nine datasets, and three generation regimes (short-form QA, long-form generation, and code generation), we provide a systematic robustness analysis along three axes: sample efficiency, in-domain dataset transfer, and generation regime dependence. translated_title: 监督式UQ集成何时能提升LLM幻觉检测？一项稳健性研究
translated_abstract: 不确定性量化（UQ）方法广泛用于大型语言模型（LLMs）在封闭书设置中的幻觉检测，该场景下推理时无法获得真实证据。先前工作提出了通过学习的集成组合UQ信号，但对这些集成稳健性的实证研究有限。我们研究了一个监督式集成框架，该框架在小型、领域特定的标记LLM响应数据集上训练一个分类器，对基于异构UQ的评分器输出进行训练，然后将其应用于无检索、工具或参考文档的样本外幻觉分类。在四个LLM、九个数据集和三种生成模式（短问答、长文生成和代码生成）下，我们沿三个轴提供了系统性稳健性分析：样本效率、领域内数据集转移和生成模式依赖性。我们发现监督式集成优于...
tldr: 本文系统评估了监督式UQ集成在不同LLM、数据集和生成模式下的稳健性，发现其性能提升受限于特定条件，并非普遍适用。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates the robustness of supervised UQ ensembles across various LLMs, datasets, and generation regimes, finding that performance improvements are conditional and not universally applicable.
